_provenance.closed_form: Mironov-Talwar-Zhang 2019 Theorem 4 for sub-sampled Gaussian RDP; min over alpha grid; CKS-2020 Prop 12 for (epsilon, delta) conversion (tighter than Mironov 2017 Prop 3 by log((alpha-1)/alpha)).
_provenance.notes: Reference values cross-checked against the closed-form math above. Opacus 1.5.x uses the same conversion (PR #500). Tolerance is absolute, not relative, so the test is robust on log-scale epsilon near 0. Tolerances are wide enough to absorb small numerical-form differences (e.g., Opacus may use a slightly different alpha grid or numerical expansion) while still trapping a factor-of-2 calibration error. A factor-of-2 sigma error would move epsilon by ~4x for any case here and would trip the tolerance trivially.
